verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm Devin's docs serve a live llms.txt index (HTTP 200) organized by section. Per-page Markdown versions are also served, and each one embeds a pointer telling agents to fetch the llms.txt index. Separately, Devin documents AGENTS.md support for consuming agent-oriented instructions. Missing for 10: no evidence of a consolidated llms-full.txt, and no independent community corroboration of agents using these docs in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.devin.ai/llms.txt # Devin Docs
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.devin.ai/llms.txt
Devin supports AGENTS.md - a simple, open standard for providing context and instructions to AI agents.
